The academic year consists of a 16-week (Fall Semester) and a 15-week Spring semester, with a 15-week summer term acting as a trailer to the academic year.
The 15-week summer term may be optional or required depending on the student’s program.
Each semester also contains two consecutive seven-week mini-sessions.
